summary: Crouton Alpha is a lightweight model for coding, agentic sub-tasks, tool use, and document analysis, with a 1M token context, image input, and low, medium, high, xhigh, and max reasoning effort. Its maker has chosen to stay anonymous for the preview. Requests cost no credits: input and output are both $0.00 per million tokens. It is available to all customers (Go, GOAT, Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team Pro), with 1000 requests a day per account and a quota that resets at midnight UTC. You need $1 of credits in your account to start a session. The provider may keep your prompts and outputs, so Crouton Alpha won't run in a CMD_ZDR=1 session. A stealth preview can change or end without notice. The free preview ended by November 13, 2026: Command Code's pricing page no longer lists Crouton Alpha, and OpenRouter ended the model's stealth preview on November 10.
claim_steps: Ended November 13, 2026: Command Code no longer lists Crouton Alpha (its free stealth model is now Glyph Cluster). The steps below describe how it was claimed during the preview.
Sign in to Command Code and keep at least $1 of credits in your account
Pick crouton-alpha (switch any time with /model in interactive mode)
